summary: Added the protective counterpart to the sparse-pid trim finding: the snapshot path bounds compaction only by the local decided index (try_snapshot rejects only indices above decided) and never consults the minimum accepted index, so a snapshot-capable entry type can still compact a {1,2,5} configuration. Recorded as a source-level behavior with two new anchors plus the trim-check anchor, keeping the trim defect's scope precise (trim API, not compaction in general). All four defect accounts and the earlier buffered-proposal protection remain unchanged.
